scope: Compiler-mechanism study (scratch candidates/rotor) for the residue shared by TITLE 0x9a40, 0x9c90, 0xa020 and 0xd910 (size-exact RECONSTRUCTED rows). Diagnostic only; canonical sources unchanged.
toolchain: pinned VC5 RTM /O2; pinned SP2 identical; unpinned msvc5_sp3 identical (diagnostic)
mechanism: In every original 999-loop sound call the value lands in eax (9a40 x2, 9c90 x3, a020 x2, d910 x4) regardless of address register or rotor position, and never advances the scratch rotor: it is assigned by the named-local route (first free register, no rotor advance; sister-project rule VC5-RA-01). Our value is an ordinary expression temp that takes the rotor register and advances it once per loop, which shifts every later scratch choice.
prediction: Routing the value through a range that survives to register assignment gives eax and one fewer rotor step; falsifier: edx remains. Confirmed.

minimal_pair.A_expression_temp: snd(U[h+1] | 0x4000, p); -> movsx edx,[eax+U+2]; mov ecx,[p]; or dh,40h; push ecx; push edx; next block eax/edx/cx
minimal_pair.B_address_taken_local: int v, *pv = &v; *pv = U[h+1] | 0x4000; snd(v, p); -> movsx eax,...; or ah,40h; push ecx; push eax; next block edx/ecx/ax (original pattern)
minimal_pair.size: 112 bytes each, identical instruction sequences except registers

diagnostic_results.address_taken_local: all four MASKED EQUAL, 0xa450 stays equal, 0 unit regressions (steering form, not adopted)
diagnostic_results.struct_argument_loops_only: all four MASKED EQUAL (contradicts the constant calls, not adopted)

rejected: argument evaluation order (0xd910 has a single temp; swapping callee parameters breaks 0x9c90)
inert: every scalar local (block or function scope, short/int/register)
struct-field locals read back as scalars
why_no_admissible_form: C copy propagation removes every scalar local; a value only survives as a range when pushed as an aggregate or address-taken. The original constant calls (push 0x430a/0x430c/0x4311/0x4316) are plain dword pushes, so a by-value struct parameter is contradicted. An unprototyped/old-style callee taking a real 4-byte sound struct in the loops would need owner review and evidence from callee 0x54f0, which reads the argument as a dword masked with 0xffff/0xf800/0x4000.
side_finding: Adding only the unused prototype title_054f0_sw(TitleObject*, int) changes 0xa450 by 16 bytes while other names do not: name-dependent hashed symbol keys (VC5-RA-06); choose new names in u09a40.c carefully.
